facts.fact: The Central Bureau of Statistics, with UNDP, issued the Sudan Multidimensional Poverty Survey 2023 report (dated June 2026), described as a nationally representative household survey covering 185 of 189 localities; the date is the report's cover date, the page being published 2026-07-26.
The report refers to 2008 as the year of the national census, whose population and household counts still underlie the survey sampling frame.
